prompt: After leaving the pet shop, I told Sam the kittens arrived (here) on Tuesdays.
explanation_ru: Говорящий уже ушёл из зоомагазина, поэтому при пересказе слово места here меняется на there.

prompt: On Monday, Karim promised he would bring fresh mint (tomorrow) before noon.
explanation_ru: В косвенной речи при глаголе в прошедшем времени (promised) слово tomorrow меняется на the next day или the following day.

prompt: In her kitchen, Grandma warned us not to bake bread in (this) electric oven.
explanation_ru: При передаче слов, сказанных в другом месте и времени, указательное местоимение this меняется на that.

prompt: At Doha airport, Omar explained that my passport was not clear, so I had to stay in town (tonight).
explanation_ru: Речь передаётся позже, поэтому в косвенной речи tonight переходит в that night.

prompt: The radio reporter said on Tuesday that snow would reach the north ___.
explanation_ru: В косвенной речи tonight меняется на that night; частая ошибка — оставить tonight без изменения или перевести дословно как this night.

prompt: Katja read her mum's email about the broken sink in Berlin. Her mum wrote that the plumber was not coming (today) after all. She asked if Katja could wait (here) to let him in and check (my) kitchen tap. Katja sighed and cancelled her morning plans.
explanation_ru: В пересказе письма из прошлого today переходит в that day, here — в there, а местоимение my от лица мамы меняется на her.

prompt: Later at the café, we remembered the cinema notice said the film started here.
answer: Later at the café, we remembered the cinema notice said the film started there.
accepted_answers: Later at the café, we remembered the cinema notice said the film started there.
Later at the café, we remembered that the cinema notice said the film started there.
Later at the café, we remembered the cinema notice said that the film started there.
explanation_ru: Герои находятся уже в кафе, а не в кинотеатре, поэтому here нужно заменить на there; типичная ошибка — оставлять here без сдвига.

prompt: Outside the village bakery, the baker mentioned that the loaves from (yesterday) were half price after noon, so Claire bought two.
explanation_ru: В косвенной речи слово yesterday заменяется на the day before или the previous day.

prompt: At the café, Sophie told me, "I'm taking my train to the coast tomorrow." → Sophie told me …
answer: Sophie told me she was taking her train to the coast the next day.
accepted_answers: Sophie told me she was taking her train to the coast the next day.
Sophie told me that she was taking her train to the coast the next day.
Sophie told me she was taking her train to the coast the following day.
Sophie told me that she was taking her train to the coast the following day.
explanation_ru: При переводе в косвенную речь меняются местоимения (I → she, my → her), время (am taking → was taking) и маркер tomorrow → the next/following day.

prompt: In Helsinki, Jonas told me (your) new glasses would be ready on Thursday.
explanation_ru: Йонас обращался ко мне (told me), поэтому в пересказе его your переходит в my.

prompt: During a school trip to an old fort in Lisbon, Diogo listened carefully to the tour guide. Pointing at the stone tower, the guide explained that guards had once watched the river from (this) high wall. One boy asked if (we) could climb the stairs to see the view. The guide smiled and added that the class would visit the river gate (tomorrow) instead.
explanation_ru: Повествование ведётся в прошедшем времени со стороны, поэтому this меняется на that, местоимение we от лица школьников — на they, а tomorrow — на the next/following day.

prompt: Back home from Bali, we joked that the receptionist had promised the pool stayed open ___, though a storm closed it early.
explanation_ru: Герои уже вернулись домой, поэтому сдвинуть нужно оба слова: here → there и tonight → that night; частая ошибка — изменить только одно из них.

prompt: The queue in Vancouver was long, and the recruiter announced they would start the interviews (next week).
explanation_ru: В косвенной речи после глагола в прошедшем времени (announced) выражение next week меняется на the following week или the next week.

prompt: While packing up his brushes at a village art fair in Tuscany, Marco complained to his neighbour that (yesterday) a huge crowd had stood watching (me) paint without buying a single picture.
explanation_ru: Речь Марко передаётся в третьем лице и позже по времени, поэтому yesterday переходит в the day before/previous day, а me — в him.

prompt: On Friday night in New Orleans, a jazz player smiled at us from the stage and said, "We play here again tomorrow night, so tell your friends." Which sentence reports this correctly the next week?
options: The jazz player told us we played here again tomorrow night and advised us to tell your friends.
The jazz player told us they played here again the next night and advised us to tell their friends.
The jazz player told us they played there again the night before and advised us to tell our friends.
The jazz player told us they played there again the next night and advised us to tell our friends.
explanation_ru: Только последний вариант верно сдвигает все элементы: we → they (музыканты), here → there, tomorrow night → the next night и your → our (обращение к нам).

prompt: Early in the term, our science teacher explained that our test results would go on the board tomorrow.
answer: Early in the term, our science teacher explained that our test results would go on the board the next day.
accepted_answers: Early in the term, our science teacher explained that our test results would go on the board the next day.
Early in the term, our science teacher explained that our test results would go on the board the following day.
explanation_ru: Событие относится к началу семестра, поэтому tomorrow нельзя оставлять без изменения — нужно the next day или the following day.

prompt: At a night-sky station in South Africa, Theo checked the sky with his team. He announced that the bright comet would not pass overhead (tonight). Instead, he advised the younger helpers to check (your) cameras and pack (these) extra lenses carefully. Nobody wanted to miss the show.
explanation_ru: При передаче слов Тео в прошедшем времени tonight переходит в that night, обращение your к помощникам — в their, а указательное these — в those.

prompt: The race manager told us (you) would start behind the old church.
explanation_ru: Организатор обращался к нам (told us), поэтому его местоимение you в косвенной речи превращается в we.

prompt: In an email, Nadia told her boss ___ finish the new app.
explanation_ru: В косвенной речи I меняется на she, а can — на could; частая ошибка — сохранить местоимение I или настоящее время cannot.

prompt: Jihoon rode the airport bus in Seoul with his friends. He asked the driver if (we) were near Gate D (now). The driver smiled and said the bus stop was right outside the door. Their guide waved at them from the steps.
explanation_ru: Мы пересказываем вопрос Джихуна в третьем лице, поэтому we меняется на they, а слово времени now — на then.

prompt: At Sofia station, I asked a woman about the night bus, and she replied that (I) had no tickets (today).
explanation_ru: Слова принадлежат кассирше (she replied), поэтому её I меняется на she, а today в прошедшем пересказе — на that day.

prompt: Wanjiku missed two university lectures in Nairobi because she was ill. After class, Peter messaged her and promised to bring (my) full notes to the hall. He explained that she did not need to worry about (these) hard chapters alone. He also added that he (will / to help) her revise before the test.
explanation_ru: В пересказе сообщения Питера my меняется на his, указательное these — на those, а will help после глагола added переходит в would help.

prompt: The cousins frowned because the park ranger had warned them that a storm would hit their campsite that night.
answer: The cousins frowned because the park ranger had warned them that a storm would hit their campsite that night.
accepted_answers: The cousins frowned because the park ranger had warned them that a storm would hit their campsite that night.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: все сдвиги косвенной речи выполнены верно (will → would, your → their, tonight → that night).

prompt: Back at his desk across town, Lukas groaned because the clerk had reminded him the manager ___ at noon.
explanation_ru: Лукас находится уже в другом конце города, поэтому нужны оба сдвига: will → would и here → there; частая ошибка — забыть заменить here на there.

prompt: We had a big rehearsal at our drama school in Bristol. Our teacher reminded (you) to meet outside the back door at nine sharp. Priya asked whether (I) needed a black coat for the scene. The teacher replied that she (will / to bring) spare coats for anyone who forgot.
explanation_ru: Учитель обращался к нам, поэтому you переходит в us; вопрос Прии передаётся в третьем лице (I → she), а will bring после replied сдвигается в would bring.

prompt: Hana, a career adviser in Auckland, attached a map and wrote that the interview would be held at (our) main office, adding that anyone who got lost could call (me).
explanation_ru: Мы пересказываем письмо Ханы от третьего лица, поэтому our (офис её компании) переходит в their, а me (сама Хана) — в her.

prompt: Callum interviewed a museum expert inside an old castle gallery in Edinburgh. The expert explained that the painted ceiling had been cleaned (last year), though the room was not ready for visitors. She admitted that (our) small team needed extra time to check the old lights. However, she promised that visitors (can) see the painted room in spring.
explanation_ru: В косвенной речи last year переходит в the year before/previous year, our от лица сотрудницы музея — в their, а модальный can после promised — в could.

prompt: As the queue at a Riyadh mall grew longer, Layla admitted to the cashier that she had left her bank card at home and could not pay for (myself).
explanation_ru: Речь Лейлы передаётся в третьем лице, поэтому возвратное местоимение myself меняется на herself.

prompt: After returning from the swimming contest in Budapest, Bence told his parents that the official had warned him to stay near the pool because the final would begin ___.
explanation_ru: Бенце пересказывает события уже после возвращения, поэтому here переходит в there, а in five minutes — в five minutes later; частая ошибка — забыть сдвинуть одно из выражений.

prompt: Once I returned to my hotel in Hanoi, I messaged my colleague that Minh had promised to return my laptop from this repair shop before Friday.
answer: Once I returned to my hotel in Hanoi, I messaged my colleague that Minh had promised to return my laptop from that repair shop before Friday.
accepted_answers: Once I returned to my hotel in Hanoi, I messaged my colleague that Minh had promised to return my laptop from that repair shop before Friday.
explanation_ru: Говорящий уже вернулся в отель и не находится в мастерской, поэтому this нужно заменить на that; типичная ошибка — забывать сдвиг this → that.

prompt: Stopping at a motorway service area in Poland, a coach driver told his passengers, "We are leaving this car park in twenty minutes, so nobody should stay behind here." Later that evening, which sentence reports his words accurately?
options: The driver announced that they were leaving this car park twenty minutes later and warned that nobody should stay behind there.
The driver announced that they were leaving that car park twenty minutes later and warned that nobody should stay behind there.
The driver announced that we were leaving that car park twenty minutes later and warned that nobody should stay behind there.
The driver announced that they were leaving that car park in twenty minutes and warned that nobody should stay behind here.
explanation_ru: Во втором варианте верно изменены все элементы: we → they, this → that, in twenty minutes → twenty minutes later и here → there.
